This is such a ridiculous and dishonest framing.
Elon is already one of the richest men to have ever existed. Every big tech company has monopoly-like margins. The USA is the only game in town globally when it comes to technology and the lead is obviously expanding as Europe manages itself into third world status. 
There is no labor shortage. If anything there’s too much labor.
A country actually concerned with the well being of its citizens would break up all these digital monopolies and freeze immigration. 
Instead the Elon’s of the world slander Americans as “lazy racists” when we actually advocate for our collective interests, further exacerbating class resentment.

Elon Musk: This is the right position for those who want America to win. 
For those who want America to lose for their own personal gain, I have no respect. Zero.
